items.title: Separate META audit containers from unfinished story completion in convergence_check
items.context: Update packages/main/src/tasks/gap-analyze.ts: checkConvergence should exclude phase=META from the 所有 Story 完成 active story list. Add a separate audit backlog check for B-META-framework-audit open findings; only evidenceState=verified with severity high or critical should make convergence fail. suspected and low/medium findings should be advisory/detail-only.
items.userSees: convergence_check no longer lists B-META-framework-audit under unfinished stories; it reports audit backlog separately and only blocks on verified high/critical audit findings.

happy.desc: Run koala convergence_check with current repo: 所有 Story 完成 lists only real active INIT stories, not B-META-framework-audit; audit backlog appears as a separate check

edge.desc: Smoke fixture with DONE, DISCARDED, META, INIT proves META is excluded while INIT remains unfinished

adversarial.desc: Smoke fixture proves only verified high/critical audit findings block convergence; suspected and low/medium audit findings do not block

items.title: Resolve B-META-framework-audit F-004 with B-4c38 evidence
items.context: B-META-framework-audit:F-004 is open verified but the fix has already merged in commit 7350e9df (B-4c38 Serialize DONE main merges and add partial-DONE recovery). Resolve that finding with a clear reason/evidence, without touching other open findings or INIT backlog stories.
items.userSees: finding_list for B-META-framework-audit shows F-004 resolved, while unrelated findings remain unchanged.

happy.desc: Run koala finding_list for B-META-framework-audit and verify F-004 status is resolved with B-4c38/7350e9df rationale

edge.desc: Confirm F-005 remains dismissed duplicate and F-001/F-002/F-003/F-006 are not modified by this story
